the sunstone lava flow itself. Scan the surface for glassy yellowish feldspar, then screen the topsoil through a 1/4-inch screen; better stones come from pockets of decomposed basalt under 1-6 ft of soil (Peterson 1972 p.212). Wind leaves the coarse pieces in low spots on the flow (p.204). A big area: start at the road point and work outward.
broken, angular pieces (within about 3 km of the source; Attal & Lave 2009)
